revocation_window.basis: chain time: the order's timestamps from its view at the withhold step, and the relay pre-check's final-block read after the runner confirmed removal
revocation_window.note: remaining_after_confirmed_removal is how long the withheld order would still have been executable for an owner who stopped authorizing and waited, from the same moment; a lower bound, since removal was final before the read. sign_request_to_signed_ms runs from the block of the MPC sign request to the block of the contract's signature callback (MPC signing plus the yield/resume round trip).

timing.note: at and wall_remaining_ms use the runner's clock; chain_ns and remaining_ms use the final block's timestamp, which the verifier's deadline check follows. A phase confirmed by runner is the time its step's terminal verification was recorded (after a reconciling resume, if the response was lost), not the block time of finality
